candidates.title: Two column adoption certificate layout redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout featuring a live companion pet preview alongside input fields for immediate visual feedback.
candidates.why: Adoption step completion drops to 67.6% with a high median time of 89s, and support received complaints regarding pet appearance and generation issues.

guard.reason: The redesigned adoption certificate removes the required official stamp.

candidates.title: Interactive desktop control showcase layout
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a split layout that visually demonstrates how to trigger, hide, and speak to the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step conversion is low at 64.8%.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the home intro screen showcasing desktop pet controls.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the largest drop-off step (finish at 64.8%) backed by clear support feedback, though layout redesign requires effort.

candidates.title: Pre-adoption custom pet style selection flow
candidates.change: Insert a new style customization screen before pick_friend allowing users to select visual art themes before choosing or creating a pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets mentioned custom pet rendering issues and aesthetic mismatch during creation.

new_style_picker.headline: Select Pet Art Style
new_style_picker.body: Choose the visual style for your desktop pet before selection.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a style picker screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets high-drop adoption step, but adding a new step screen increases friction.

candidates.title: Onboarding path decision story reel redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story intro screen into an engaging carousel format with dynamic mascot media showcasing desktop pet interactions.
candidates.why: The choose_path mean time is very high (514s), suggesting users get distracted or lack clear context early on.

guard.reason: Valid carousel redesign of the story screen while retaining pet introduction.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has lower drop-off than adoption/finish and lacks strong support mail evidence.

candidates.title: Account pet sync and recovery banner
candidates.change: Add a highlighted sync badge on the sign_in screen clarifying that existing pets and profiles are automatically synced upon logging in.
candidates.why: The top support theme with 8 emails involved missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically restores your existing pets and settings across devices.

guard.reason: Valid hint added to sign in screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 emails), low cost hint banner, though sign_in step conversion is already relatively high.

candidates.title: Pet generation waiting estimated time callout
candidates.change: Enable explicit time estimates and active progress indicators on the waiting screen while background assets render.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off and support questions about stuck rendering.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Desktop Pet...
waiting.hint: Usually takes under 2 minutes. Your pet will automatically appear on your screen once complete.

guard.reason: Valid progress and time estimate display during actual waiting time.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets high wait times (mean 2336s) at home step with clear support and funnel evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop hide and summon quick tips component
candidates.change: Display a quick key shortcut callout on the home_intro screen explaining how to hide and reveal the desktop pet instantly.
candidates.why: Multiple users wrote support asking how to manage, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

home_intro.hint: Shortcut Tip: Right-click your pet or press Alt+P to hide or summon them anytime.

guard.reason: Valid informational hint added to home intro.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint targeting the lowest converting step (finish 64.8%) with strong support evidence.

candidates.title: Custom pet photo validation hint
candidates.change: Add inline photo requirement guidelines on upload_photos specifying lighting and framing details for accurate pet generation.
candidates.why: Support logs indicate users experienced failures or visual errors when creating custom pets from uploaded photos.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with a single subject facing forward.

guard.reason: Valid photo guidelines hint added to upload photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost inline hint targeting substantial adoption step drop-off caused by photo errors.

candidates.title: Path choice speed boost incentive badge
candidates.change: Place a reward callout on choose_path informing users they unlock starter accessory items upon selecting their onboarding path.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is long (514s) and total conversion across the funnel is only 24.7%.

choose_path.hint: Select your path now to claim a free starter accessory bundle for your pet!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions free gifts and starter extras.

candidates.title: Desktop pet interaction safety info screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pre-finish screen (new_pet_controls) detailing screen overlay settings and sound controls before landing on home_intro.
candidates.why: Support reported issue themes around pet not displaying on desktop and desktop features misbehaving post-setup.

new_pet_controls.headline: Desktop Display & Overlay Permissions
new_pet_controls.body: Confirm how your pet appears on top of desktop windows and plays audio interactions.

guard.reason: Valid new onboarding screen for desktop display and audio permissions.

candidates.score_note: Adding an extra screen before finish step risks increasing drop-off despite addressing support issues.
